content: {"reasoning":"The prior CO-197 denial reflects missing required authorization, and this payer offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review. An appeal has already been submitted with no response on the table; another appeal is unavailable, and correcting the invalid diagnosis pairing would not resolve the authorization denial. CO-197 does not establish patient liability despite the remaining deductible, and writing off is premature while the appeal is unresolved, so specialist follow-up is the only available action that can properly progress the claim.","action":"escalate"}
